title: add_on_set_parameters_callback not called in ROS 2: dropped handles, late registration and no spin, measured
excerpt: Why a ROS 2 parameter callback never runs: a dropped C++ handle, registering after declare_parameter, a node that never spins, a Python callback returning None, and ParameterModifiedInCallbackException. Pre-set, post-set and timer fixes compared in rclpy and rclcpp on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
